fault_mode: A failed stub endpoint discard path leaks endpoint ownership; out-of-order discard callbacks can corrupt endpoint reference accounting.
trigger: Force endpoint configuration changes and failed stub endpoint handling while discard callbacks complete out of order.
observation: Resource growth across endpoint churn, failed teardown, or unstable reference accounting during asynchronous completion.
recovery: Endpoint teardown must complete without residual resources, negative reference state, or loss of ability to establish new endpoints.
